name: Iosla
desc: A charming seaside town centered around an ancient gnarled oak tree with massive spreading branches in the town square.

text: What kind of buildings surround me?
You look around and see many small houses, with a tavern a little ways down the road.

desc: A local fisherman with a weathered face.

text: An old weathered man sits next to you and is fishing in the rainy afternoon.
The road is clear save for the fisherman next to you.
And the town is generally quiet.
There are a few townsfolk heading up the stairs, carrying creatures and furniture into the town hall.
You make your way to the tavern. Hearing the commotion inside, you notice that you see why the fisherman washes away his morning there with ale.

desc: The local house guard of this dusty seaside town.
A man in a tall black top hat and a black smock.

text: Inside there is a giant grim man standing by the heater, wiping a plate!
A man in a tall black top hat and a black smock is loudly arguing with him.
The room is divided between working class soldiers sitting merrily and then the elite sitting and carousing at the end of the room.
What would you like to do?
